scope: entire downloaded AB extract, not Kakwa study cohort
method: Independent DuckDB SQL on all-string CSV; matched Python csv/Decimal profile
sql:
SELECT count(*) AS source_rows,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE ActivityID='PROD' AND ProductID='GAS') AS qualifying_rows,
 count(DISTINCT ReportingFacilityID) FILTER (WHERE ActivityID='PROD' AND ProductID='GAS') AS facilities,
 sum(try_cast(Volume AS DECIMAL(18,3))) FILTER (WHERE ActivityID='PROD' AND ProductID='GAS') AS volume_e3m3
 FROM read_csv(?, all_varchar=true, header=true)
